title: Summit Qualifying Dollars for a Retro-Credited Segment: Computation
content:
Under the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, the qualifying dollars posted for a segment credited by a retro credit are computed as follows.

**Segment.** The segment is the one named by the latest retro credit entry on the membership. Its eligible fare, its ticket and its flight date are the ones that entry records.

**Share qualifying dollars.** The share qualifying dollars of the segment are its eligible fare multiplied by its qualifying share percent, rounded to the cent. The qualifying share percent is 100 percent.

**Posting.** The qualifying dollars posted for the segment are its share qualifying dollars, in dollars and cents.

| Latest retro credit entry records | Taken as |
|---|---|
| Ticket and segment | The segment whose qualifying dollars are posted |
| Eligible fare | The amount the share qualifying dollars are computed on |
| Flight date | The flight date of the posting |

**Worked figures on hypothetical entries**

- A latest retro credit entry recording an eligible fare of 480.00 USD gives share qualifying dollars of 480.00 USD, and 480.00 USD are posted.
- One recording 212.37 USD gives 212.37 USD.

**Which entry.** Where the membership has several retro credit entries, the latest one names the segment; an earlier entry's fare is not used.
